reason: Enhances the web Settings → Plugins list by displaying package descriptions, marking third-party plugins, and supporting search by description.

summaries.zh: 在 Web 设置的插件列表中显示插件包描述、标记第三方插件，并支持按描述搜索。
summaries.en: Enhances the web plugin list with package descriptions, third-party labels, and description-based search.

capabilities: Displays plugin package descriptions in the web plugin list
Labels non-built-in plugins as third party
Extends plugin-list search to include descriptions and third-party labels
